g.text: 1. CONTROLLER - existing XIAO SAMD21; no display or battery

g.desc: 1. CONTROLLER - existing XIAO SAMD21; no display or battery

g.text: FLOOR 2 - XIAO SAMD21 / USB CDC / EXTERNAL ADC REQUIRED

g.desc: FLOOR 2 - XIAO SAMD21 / USB CDC / EXTERNAL ADC REQUIRED

g.text: 3. INTERBOARD LINK - same logical pin numbers as sensor J1

g.desc: 3. INTERBOARD LINK - same logical pin numbers as sensor J1

g.text: Timer/event/DMA firmware required. analogRead() loop is not an acquisition design.

g.desc: Timer/event/DMA firmware required. analogRead() loop is not an acquisition design.

g.text: D1/PA04: TCC0 clock. D6/PB08: TRG/EIC8. A0/PA02: ADC AIN0.

g.desc: D1/PA04: TCC0 clock. D6/PB08: TRG/EIC8. A0/PA02: ADC AIN0.

g.text: A1 pad 14 (5V after diode) is NC. Sensor uses regulated ANALOG_5V from power sheet.

g.desc: A1 pad 14 (5V after diode) is NC. Sensor uses regulated ANALOG_5V from power sheet.

g.text: J8/J7: optional bench test headers on floor 2; shared labels connect the power sheet.

g.desc: J8/J7: optional bench test headers on floor 2; shared labels connect the power sheet.

g.text: External spectral ADC pending; A0 path is legacy bench wiring, not the selected acquisition.

g.desc: External spectral ADC pending; A0 path is legacy bench wiring, not the selected acquisition.

g.text: Confirm timings/voltages with oscilloscope before attaching the expensive sensor.

g.desc: Confirm timings/voltages with oscilloscope before attaching the expensive sensor.

g.text: Bench target: fCLK = 200 kHz; sample 288 pixels at the correct TRG phase.

g.desc: Bench target: fCLK = 200 kHz; sample 288 pixels at the correct TRG phase.

g.text: Power sheet: USB_5V -> boost -> LT3045 -> ANALOG_5V. Verify 4.75-5.25 V at U2.

g.desc: Power sheet: USB_5V -> boost -> LT3045 -> ANALOG_5V. Verify 4.75-5.25 V at U2.

g.text: Use an intact verified OTG/captive cable assembly. No CC termination is designed here.

g.desc: Use an intact verified OTG/captive cable assembly. No CC termination is designed here.

g.text: J5 represents a physical plug into A1 onboard USB-C, not edge-pad USB signals.

g.desc: J5 represents a physical plug into A1 onboard USB-C, not edge-pad USB signals.

g.text: 4. USB POWER AND DATA - split RAW VBUS before the XIAO diode

g.desc: 4. USB POWER AND DATA - split RAW VBUS before the XIAO diode

g.text: Connector height/orientation and cuvette clearance remain mechanical choices.

g.desc: Connector height/orientation and cuvette clearance remain mechanical choices.

g.text: D1/D2 limit excursions; R5 limits current. Keep 3V3 present with sensor power.

g.desc: D1/D2 limit excursions; R5 limits current. Keep 3V3 present with sensor power.

g.text: Confirm BAT54WS polarity/footprint. Validate ADC settling with R5 and diode capacitance.

g.desc: Confirm BAT54WS polarity/footprint. Validate ADC settling with R5 and diode capacitance.

g.text: Fit only one effective I2C pull-up pair if the AS7331 module has pull-ups.

g.desc: Fit only one effective I2C pull-up pair if the AS7331 module has pull-ups.
